title: From inbox dread to in control
excerpt: AI sorts the noise - you keep the final say. PureBox groups routine clutter so you can clear it in batches, reclaiming hours of your time every week.

Works inside your real Gmail

AI sorts the noise - you keep the final say.

Stop sorting newsletters, promos, and receipts one message at a time. PureBox groups the clutter so you can review it in batches and see the time your own inbox could give back.

See your own estimated time in the free scan.

How it works

PureBox tailors its cleanup to your inbox from the very first scan - using your own Gmail history, so suggestions fit your routine.

Connect Gmail

One secure sign-in. PureBox reads the patterns in your inbox - who you open, reply to, and archive.

PureBox sorts it

Every message is triaged into three tracks, with a plain-language reason for each suggestion.

You review & approve

Nothing moves until you say so. Approve a whole track in one click, or pick through it - your call.

Bills, deadlines, people, and important updates - kept visible so nothing that matters gets buried.

Receipts, confirmations, and updates worth keeping - labeled by category and filed so they are easy to find later.

Low-value clutter you would never miss - removed only after you approve, and reversible if you change your mind.

The point of all this

Inbox triage is death by a thousand small decisions. PureBox makes those decisions for you and hands back the time - so your week is not quietly eaten by sorting.

Time estimates are illustrative, based on a typical few seconds per email of manual triage applied across your scanned inbox.

hours reclaimable in a first scan

Built on trust

PureBox is review-first by design. It surfaces what it would do, explains why, and waits for you - so cleaning your inbox never means losing track of it.

See how we handle your data

Show before act

Every suggestion is visible with a reason before anything happens. You approve - PureBox never acts on its own.

Always reversible

Cleanups happen in your real Gmail and stay reversible. Changed your mind? Move it back, no harm done.

Official Google OAuth

Connect with Google - never your password. Your email is never sold. Revoke access anytime from your Google account.

PureBox MCP Server

When your assistant supports Remote MCP using the Model Context Protocol, it can ask PureBox about cleanup and use guarded PureBox actions - without receiving your Gmail login or tokens.

No credit card requiredOfficial Google OAuthResults in a couple of minutes

Is it safe?

Yes. PureBox is review-first: it shows what it would do and waits for your approval, so nothing happens to your inbox without you. It connects through official Google OAuth, asks only for the access it needs, and you can revoke that access anytime from your Google account.

Do you read my emails?

PureBox analyzes your email to classify it - sender, subject, and signals about how you have handled similar mail before. It does not read your mail for any other purpose, connects through official Google OAuth, and never sells your email.

See the details

Can I undo a cleanup?

Yes. Cleanups happen in your real Gmail and stay reversible. Archived mail moves to a label, trashed mail sits in Trash, and your History shows exactly what changed so you can move anything back.

Does it delete things automatically?

No. Nothing is deleted or moved until you approve it. PureBox proposes actions across Attention, Archive, and Trash; you approve a whole track at once or pick through it. On Pro you can opt into automatic handling of patterns you already trust.

What's free vs paid?

Free is a sample scan that proves the value - you see your real Attention, Archive, and Trash split and your estimated reclaimable time. Pro covers your entire inbox with no sample cap and keeps classifying new mail as it arrives. Pro is $4.99/mo billed yearly, or $7.99 monthly.

Do I have to switch email apps?

No. PureBox works inside your existing Gmail. There is no new inbox to learn and no app to live in - you keep using Gmail exactly as you do now, just tidier.

Do I need this if I already pay for ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude?

They do different jobs. Your assistant is great for drafting, summarizing, and thinking through a message. PureBox reviews your whole inbox and safely sorts it into Attention, Archive, and Trash - review-first, reversible, and tuned to how you work. It is built to work alongside the assistant you already pay for, not replace it.

安全吗？

是的。 PureBox 是审核优先的：它会显示它将执行的操作并等待您的批准，因此如果没有您，您的收件箱不会发生任何变化。 它通过官方 Google OAuth 连接，仅请求其所需的访问权限，并且您可以随时从 Google 帐户撤销该访问权限。

你读我的电子邮件吗？

PureBox 分析您的电子邮件并对其进行分类 - 发件人、主题以及有关您之前如何处理类似邮件的信号。 它不会出于任何其他目的读取您的邮件，通过官方 Google OAuth 连接，并且绝不会出售您的电子邮件。

我可以撤消清理吗？

是的。 清理工作在您真实的 Gmail 中进行，并且保持可逆。 存档的邮件会移至标签，已删除的邮件会放在“垃圾箱”中，您的历史记录会准确显示更改的内容，以便您可以将任何内容移回原处。

它会自动删除东西吗？

不会。在您批准之前，不会删除或移动任何内容。 PureBox 提出了跨注意力、存档和垃圾的行动；您可以立即批准整首曲目或从中挑选。 在专业版上，您可以选择自动处理您已经信任的模式。

什么是免费与付费？

免费是一个证明其价值的示例扫描 - 您可以看到真实的注意力、存档和垃圾划分以及估计的可回收时间。 Pro 覆盖您的整个收件箱，没有样本上限，并在新邮件到达时不断对其进行分类。 Pro 的价格为每年 4.99 美元/月，或每月 7.99 美元。

我必须切换电子邮件应用程序吗？

不需要。PureBox 在您现有的 Gmail 中运行。 无需学习新的收件箱，也无需使用新的应用程序 - 您可以像现在一样继续使用 Gmail，只是更加整洁。

如果我已经支付了 ChatGPT、Gemini 或 Claude 的费用，我还需要这个吗？

他们从事不同的工作。 您的助手非常适合起草、总结和思考消息。 PureBox 会审核您的整个收件箱，并将其安全地分类为“注意”、“存档”和“垃圾箱”——审核优先、可逆，并根据您的工作方式进行调整。 它旨在与您已付费的助手一起工作，而不是取代它。
